findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cart, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, request_feature, get_seller, get_help · Private data: create_cart, quick_buy, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, get_buyer_profile, save_buyer_address, submit_feedback, request_feature, get_seller, get_policies, list_sellers, get_help · Public sink: add_to_cart, update_cart_item, set_shipping_address, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, submit_feedback, request_feature, get_seller, order_status, get_help · Destructive: get_cart, update_cart_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cart, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, request_feature, get_seller, get_help · Private data: create_cart, quick_buy, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, get_buyer_profile, save_buyer_address, submit_feedback, request_feature, get_seller, get_policies, list_sellers, get_help · Public sink: add_to_cart, update_cart_item, set_shipping_address, checkout, register_buyer, request_buyer_code, verify_buyer, get_buyer_profile, submit_feedback, request_feature, get_seller, order_status, get_help · Destructive: get_cart, update_cart_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
